```{r setup, include=FALSE}
setwd("C:/Users/cl9312/OneDrive - Princeton University/Desktop/Princeton University/Research/P1_MF374 RB-TnSeq project/Results/GK-RGI-Root Colonization")

#Install packages "data.table", "ggplot2", and "ggpubr"
install.packages("data.table")
library(data.table)
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
install.packages("ggpubr")  
library(ggpubr)

#Read Figure_2D_dat.csv
dat<-fread("Figure_2D_dat.csv")

#Define flg22 as a factor
dat$flg22 <- factor(dat$flg22, levels = c("NO", "YES"))

#Install more packages "ggsignif", "dplyr", and "magrittr" 
install.packages("ggsignif")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("magrittr")
library(dplyr)   
library(magrittr) 
library(ggsignif)

#Define strain as a factor
dat$strain<-factor(dat$strain,levels=c("NB","WT","P1","P12","P12+P1","P15"))

# make an interaction variable
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(strain_flg22 = interaction(strain, flg22, sep = "_"))

# Subset only rows where strain == "NB"
NB_data <- subset(dat, strain == "NB")

# Subset only rows where strain == "WT"
WT_data <- subset(dat, strain == "WT")

# Subset only rows where strain == "P1"
P1_data <- subset(dat, strain == "P1")

# Subset only rows where strain == "P12"
P12_data <- subset(dat, strain == "P12")

# Subset only rows where strain == "P12+P1"
P12_P1_data <- subset(dat, strain == "P12+P1")

# Subset only rows where strain == "P15"
P15_data <- subset(dat, strain == "P15")


# Recode your facet variable so "flg22" comes first
dat$flg22 <- factor(dat$flg22, levels = c("NO", "YES"))  # YES (flg22) first, then NO

# Normality check
shapiro.test(dat$Concentration)
qqnorm(dat$Concentration)
qqline(dat$Concentration, col = "red")

# Subset only rows where flg22 == "YES"
yes_data <- subset(dat, flg22 == "YES")

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from YES group
shapiro.test(yes_data$Concentration)

# Subset only rows where flg22 == "NO"
no_data <- subset(dat, flg22 == "NO")

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from YES group
shapiro.test(no_data$Concentration)

library(dplyr)

# Shapiro-Wilk test of normality per group
yes_data %>%
  group_by(strain) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = if (length(unique(Concentration)) > 1) {
      shapiro.test(Concentration)$p.value
    } else {
      NA  # mark as NA if all values are identical
    }
  )


no_data %>%
  group_by(strain) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = if (length(unique(Concentration)) > 1) {
      shapiro.test(Concentration)$p.value
    } else {
      NA  # mark as NA if all values are identical
    }
  )


# Kruskal-Wallis test
kt<-kruskal.test(Concentration ~ strain, data = dat)
kt_yes<-kruskal.test(Concentration ~ strain, data = yes_data)
kt_no<-kruskal.test(Concentration ~ strain, data = no_data)

#Dunn's test
library(FSA)

flg22<-dunnTest(Concentration ~ Group, data = dat, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(flg22$res,"flg22_stats_group.csv", row.names = FALSE)

flg22<-dunnTest(Concentration ~ strain, data = dat, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(flg22$res,"flg22_stats_strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

yes_flg22<-dunnTest(Concentration ~ strain, data = yes_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(yes_flg22$res,"yes_flg22_strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

no_flg22<-dunnTest(Concentration ~ strain, data = no_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(no_flg22$res,"no_flg22_strain.csv", row.names = FALSE)

strain_flg22<-dunnTest(Concentration ~ strain_flg22, data = dat, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
yes_strain_flg22<-dunnTest(Concentration ~ strain_flg22, data = yes_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
no_strain_flg22<-dunnTest(Concentration ~ strain_flg22, data = no_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"

# Define a 6-color palette 
strain_col13 <- c(
  "NB" = "#0c74b9",
  "WT" = "#d55427",
  "P1" = "#e5ae23",
  "P12" = "#802f89",
  "P12+P1" = "#74a641",
  "P15" = "#5abbea"
)

#Define strain_labels
strain_labels <- c(
  "P1"      = expression(Delta * italic("ppiD")),
  "P12"     = expression(Delta * italic("tonB1::Gm"^"R")),
  "P12+P1"  = expression(Delta * italic("tonB1::Gm"^"R")*Delta * italic("ppiD")),
  "P15"  = expression(Delta * italic("trpEXGDC")))
#trps:"trpE-BLR19_RS02895-trpG-trpD-trpC"

#Run ggplot for making a boxplot
p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = strain, y = Concentration, fill = strain)) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, color = "black", size = 0.6,alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = strain), size = 3, alpha = 0.6,
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
  facet_wrap(~ flg22, scales = "free_x", labeller = labeller(flg22 = c("NO" = "Mock", "YES" = "flg22-Pa"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col13,labels = strain_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = strain_col13,labels = strain_labels) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Concentration (Log CFU/mg)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(size = 2),
    axis.line = element_line(size = 1.2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", color = "black"),  # facet title size
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 8))+
  labs(
    fill  = "Strain",
    color = "Strain"
  ) 

#Show the boxplot
p

#Save the boxplot as a tiff file
ggsave("Figure 2D.tif", plot = p, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "tiff",compression = "lzw")

#Save the boxplot as a svg file
ggsave("Figure 2D.svg", plot = p, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "svg")
```
